unit.why: A short anecdote: the young Seer of Lublin recites blessings aloud before his teacher R. Shmelke, his fellow students grow jealous, and the master explains that the whole heavenly retinue answers Amen.

stories.start_quote: עוד שם בעת שהי׳ הרבי מלובלין
stories.end_quote: עונין אמן בכל הפמליא של מעלה
stories.summary_en: When the young Seer of Lublin studied with R. Shmelke he recited his blessings aloud each day for his teacher to answer Amen; when the other students grew jealous, R. Shmelke said the whole heavenly retinue answers Amen to his blessings.

quotes: אמר בכל יום הברכות בקול רם לפני רבו הרר״ש
